reconcile.note: Gill reconciles the two totals through a three-tier system of overseers, joining the top rank of 250 to the 300 above the 3,300 to reach the 550 of Kings.

sides.snippet: the chief officers who were over Solomon's work, five hundred fifty
sides.verseText: These were the chief officers who were over Solomon's work, five hundred fifty, who bore rule over the people who labored in the work.

sides.snippet: the chief officers of king Solomon, even two hundred fifty
sides.verseText: These were the chief officers of king Solomon, even two hundred fifty, who ruled over the people.
